mapper.select: SELECT f.*, sb.name as bookName, sb.author, sb.price, sb.level, sb.image, sb.status, sb.category_id as categoryId, c.name as categoryName FROM favorite f LEFT JOIN second_book sb ON f.book_id = sb.id LEFT JOIN category c ON sb.category_id = c.id WHERE f.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY f.create_time DESC
SELECT * FROM favorite WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND book_id = #{bookId}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM favorite WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND book_id = #{bookId}
